=============================================================================
  Algorithm Implementations in Python

  - Breadth-First Search (BFS)
  - Depth-First Search (DFS, recursive & iterative)
=============================================================================

from collections import deque
from typing import List, Optional, Set, Dict, Callable


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1. QUICKSORT
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# Strategy:
#   • Pick a "pivot" element.
#   • Partition the array so that:
#       - elements < pivot  go to the LEFT of the pivot
#       - elements > pivot  go to the RIGHT of the pivot
#   • Recursively sort the left and right sub-arrays.
#
# Complexity:
#   • Average time : O(n log n)
#   • Worst  time  : O(n²)   (already-sorted input + bad pivot choice)
